description:
Why
fz-9i4.7's deferrals (defer.<mode> on ~23 fixtures + 2 static guardrails) stop exercising the compiler2 dispatch/enum/float/resource paths, dropping llvm-cov line coverage from the 87 gate to ~85% (local darwin: 85.04%, 127862/150355). To keep CI green the gate was lowered to 84 in the same change.

This is scaffolding, not a new baseline. 84 is a temporary floor with ~1pt platform buffer; it must climb back.

How to apply
Each time a deferral is lifted (its root-cause ticket closes: fz-9i4.7.1/.2/.3/.4/.5/.6, fz-rh2.16.2, fz-hwn.9, fz-hwn.13), re-measure coverage and raise .coverage-threshold toward 87. When the last deferral is gone, the value must be back at 87 (or higher) and this ticket closes. Do not leave 84 standing once the fixtures return.

Check
cargo llvm-cov --all-features --workspace --summary-only --json --output-path /tmp/cov.json ; then read totals.lines.percent. CI enforces via --fail-under-lines $(cat .coverage-threshold).
title: [CHORE] Restore .coverage-threshold to 87 as deferred fixtures re-enable
